name: Keyence Corporation
guidance_fy: Keyence does not issue formal full-year earnings guidance (long-standing policy of not providing public forecasts). Management signaled intent to maintain the higher dividend (~JPY 550/sh) in FY2027. Consensus EPS FY2027 ~JPY 2,048 (vs JPY 1,836 FY2026); analyst 12m price target avg ~JPY 84,475.
notes:
FISCAL YEAR: Keyence FYE = March 31. "FY2026" = year ended Mar 31, 2026 (reported Apr 18, 2026). FY2026 RESULTS (verified via IR/press): net sales JPY 1.17T (+10.4% YoY), operating profit ~JPY 595.7B (+8.4%), op margin 51.0%, net income JPY 445.2B (+11.7%, 5th consecutive record), EPS JPY 1,835.62, ROE 13.5%, equity ratio 94.6%, total assets JPY 3.67T, cash & equiv ~JPY 451B (StockAnalysis "total cash" incl. securities JPY 1.49T). Dividend raised sharply JPY 350->550/sh, payout 30.0%. Overseas revenue +14%. FCF JPY 402.3B, FCF margin 34.4%.

VALUATION: price JPY 77,990 (StockAnalysis, 22-Jun-2026; Yahoo JPY 77,520-77,700 on 18-19 Jun). Market cap JPY ~18.91T = ~USD 114B (companiesmarketcap shows USD 117.1B; Yahoo USD 113.55B at JPY 77,520 — FX ~JPY 166/USD). Fwd P/E ~37.3 (StockAnalysis); one source showed 32.5. Trailing P/E ~42.5. PEG 3.68. fwd_pe_5y_avg NOT verified from a primary/clean source (left null); Keyence historically trades ~38-42x fwd, so current ~37x is roughly in line to modest discount vs its own history — pe_prem_disc_pct left null due to lack of verified 5y avg.

DROP CLASSIFICATION = NOT_DEPRESSED: Stock is only ~7.3% below its 52-week AND all-time high of JPY 84,170 (reached May 8, 2026). 52-week range JPY 51,510-84,170; +21-39% over trailing 12m. This is NOT a depressed/sold-off name — it is trading near record levels. There is no meaningful "drop" to classify as fear vs deterioration. NOTE: companiesmarketcap shows USD market-cap ATH of ~USD 152B at end-2021, so on a USD basis the stock is well below its 2021 USD peak (weak yen + de-rate), but in local JPY terms it is near ATH. pct_off_ath here reflects JPY local-currency ATH.

SBC: Keyence is a Japanese FA company with NO meaningful stock-based compensation program; SBC is negligible (~0% of revenue and FCF) — not a value-destruction concern for R9. Marked ESTIMATED (not separately disclosed as a line item in summary financials) but confidence high that it is immaterial.

NET CASH: Keyence carries essentially zero interest-bearing debt; balance sheet is ~95% equity with large cash + securities (>JPY 1.4T). net_debt strongly negative (~ -USD 9B using cash & securities ~JPY 1.49T / FX 166.5); nd_ebitda negative (est). EBITDA ~JPY 620B+.

GUIDANCE: Keyence famously does NOT provide formal earnings guidance. Consensus (not company guidance) FY2027 EPS ~JPY 2,048; revenue forecast ~+9.4%/yr next 3y per Simply Wall St.

GAPS: exact Q4/Q3 revenue in JPY, GAAP/adj EPS by quarter, ROIC, organic growth %, and verified 5y avg fwd P/E not obtained from primary source within timebox — these are null/estimated.
